rules.name: Coverage output
rules.what: Possible nyc coverage reports or raw coverage data beside a nyc configuration file.
rules.comeback: Check the configuration and preserve historical results before removing anything. Running coverage tests can produce new results, but cannot reproduce an earlier test run exactly.

rules.name: htmlcov
rules.what: Possible coverage.py HTML report beside a coverage configuration file.
rules.comeback: Check that this is generated output and preserve historical results first. coverage html creates reports from retained coverage data and source files; those inputs may no longer be available.
